metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy ghosted harder than my WiFi LOL Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Wait, did the enemy just vanish or did I finally get lucky?
My aim was definitely on a coffee break.

Valorant logic: delivering chaos daily.
